prompt: Create a premium character-branding poster for Kaizen, showing a single stylized anime-inspired male streetwear character in side-profile bust view, facing left. The character has sharp spiky black hair, pale skin, black wraparound sunglasses, a small hoop earring, and a black face mask with a silver eight-point star emblem. He wears a black baseball cap with a metallic star badge on the front and a small metal plate on the side, a black oversized hooded jacket, layered scarf-like black fabric, tactical straps, buckles, zippers, and metallic silver panels with repeated star insignias. Use a sleek monochrome palette of black, charcoal, silver, and light gray with high-end fashion editorial lighting, glossy 3D-anime rendering, crisp material detail, and soft studio shadows. Place him inside a large vertical light-gray rectangle centered on an off-white background. Add small clean sans-serif text at the top left reading "Character Study Studio Series 2026" on three lines. Add the name "Kaizen" in thin black type near the upper left of the gray portrait panel. Along the right edge, add huge vertical metallic silver typography reading "SILHOUETTE", rotated vertically and partially overlapping the portrait area. Keep the composition minimal, luxury, futuristic, and brand-ready, with no extra characters, no clutter, and no watermark.

promptZh: 为 Kaizen 创建一张高级角色品牌海报，展示一个单人风格化动漫街头风男性角色，侧面半身像，面向左侧。该角色拥有凌厉的黑色尖刺发型、苍白皮肤、黑色环绕式墨镜、小圆环耳环，以及带有银色八角星徽章的黑色口罩。他头戴黑色棒球帽，帽前有金属星形徽章，侧面有小金属牌，身穿黑色超大款连帽夹克，搭配层叠的围巾状黑色布料、战术绑带、扣环、拉链以及带有重复星形标志的银色金属镶板。采用黑色、炭灰色、银色和浅灰色的时尚单色调，运用高端时尚杂志的灯光效果、光泽感 3D 动漫渲染、清晰的材质细节和柔和的摄影棚阴影。将他置于米白色背景中心的一个大型垂直浅灰色矩形内。在左上角添加三行简洁的无衬线小字，内容为“Character Study Studio Series 2026”。在灰色肖像面板左上方附近，以纤细的黑色字体添加名称“Kaizen”。沿右侧边缘，添加巨大的垂直金属银色排版文字“SILHOUETTE”，垂直旋转并部分覆盖肖像区域。保持构图极简、奢华且具有品牌感，无需额外角色，避免杂乱，且不含水印。
